# 相同之下的确定 / Determinacy up to likeness

> With configurations named, determinacy is determinacy up to likeness. The theorems on how configurations relate hold up to likeness, while an intervention on one of alike configurations, an unregistered past and an unregistered description need equality.

## 主张 Claim

确定恰是主张命名配置时的相同之下的确定（determined_iff_named、alike_configurations），所以每个用 Determined 陈述的定理都是一个用 DeterminedAt 陈述者的命名实例。以下在相同之下成立：经相同而同行就是相同之下的确定（goesAlike_iff，对应 goAlike_id_iff）；相同的运行保持相同（DeterminedAt.stays_alike，对应 GoAlike.runs_agree）；一步不依赖的在相同之下被重新吸收（DependsOnlyOnAlike.reabsorbed）；遗忘噪声后，标准模型恰在噪声在相同之下无差别时在相同之下确定（forget_inputs_determinedAt_iff）；所取的动作在相同之下固定（Run.fixesAlike_of_takes），一次代表其类（Run.generalizesAlike）；在与所命名者相同的配置处从未取的动作，对在一个主张上不同的结果不被固定（Run.not_fixesAlike_of_untaken），经对整个相同类的干预（retargetAlike、retargetAlike_determinedAt）。以下需要相等，或登记相等所分开者的主张：对两个相同配置之一的改送破坏相同之下的确定（Twins.retarget_breaks）；保留的历史在其现在返回且没有什么登记过去之处在相同之下返回（keepFrame_alike_iff、keepHistory_returns_alike），所以 keepHistory_new 需要过去被登记（keepHistory_new_named）；没有主张时每个描述承载规律而没有混杂被否证（carries_unregistered、Confound.refutes_registered）。不加前提。 / Determinacy is determinacy up to likeness where the claims name the configurations (determined_iff_named, alike_configurations), so each theorem stated with Determined is the named instance of one stated with DeterminedAt. These hold up to likeness: going alike through likeness is determinacy up to likeness (goesAlike_iff, after goAlike_id_iff); runs alike stay alike (DeterminedAt.stays_alike, after GoAlike.runs_agree); what the step does not depend on is re-absorbed up to likeness (DependsOnlyOnAlike.reabsorbed); with the noise forgotten, the standard model is determined up to likeness exactly where the noise makes no difference up to likeness (forget_inputs_determinedAt_iff); a move taken is fixed up to likeness (Run.fixesAlike_of_takes) and one occasion stands for its class (Run.generalizesAlike); a move taken at no configuration alike to the one named is not fixed, for outcomes that differ in a claim (Run.not_fixesAlike_of_untaken), through an intervention on a whole likeness class (retargetAlike, retargetAlike_determinedAt). These need equality, or claims registering what equality tells apart: retargeting one of two alike configurations breaks determinacy up to likeness (Twins.retarget_breaks); a kept history returns up to likeness where its present does and nothing registers the past (keepFrame_alike_iff, keepHistory_returns_alike), so keepHistory_new needs the past registered (keepHistory_new_named); with nothing claimed, every description carries a law and no confound is refuted (carries_unregistered, Confound.refutes_registered). No premise.

P81（工作板），同上；回应 configurations-alike-by-relation 的 next_delta。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：相同是展开自身的配置同一；在相同之下成立的确定定理关乎配置如何相关，需要相等的那些依赖于所登记的：对相同者中一个名字的干预、没有登记的过去、没有登记的描述。没有登记的既不被固定也不被否证（比较 Becoming.Testing 的登记）。见整合文档 §99。 / P81 (work board), as above; answering the next_delta of configurations-alike-by-relation. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): likeness is the unfolding's own identity of configurations; the theorems with determinacy that hold up to likeness are about how configurations relate, and those that need equality depend on what is registered: an intervention on one name among alike configurations, a past nothing registers, a description nothing registers. What nothing registers is neither fixed nor refuted (compare the registers of Becoming.Testing). See the integration document §99.
